'''greatrambino1981 Dark Side Cloud City''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[greatrambino1981]]
* '''Published:''' 26 September 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[They Will Be Lost And Confused]]
* '''Strategy:''' They Will Be Lost And Confused
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 They Will Be Lost And Confused great.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Just some Cards

The published list has 59 cards.

== Strategy ==

Get the Executor out. Maybe capture some good guys along the way. Not much to drain at. Should do some nice damage if everyone gets out.
